task.title: Align spawned-scene POV with active Roleplay direction
task.source: Direct user report that Roleplay prose remained formulaic after prior prompt fixes.
task.classification: Roleplay prompt assembly and scene creation

coreClaim: New spawned scenes no longer inject an unconditional third-person instruction that conflicts with the active preset, originating chat, or explicit scene direction.
rootCause: The scene service persisted a hardcoded third-person guideline while Universal V2 could select second-person narration and limited user POV for the same scene.

inScope: Regression proof for character first-message and example-dialogue visibility
outOfScope: Changing writer models or provider parameters
Rewriting existing saved scene prompts or chat history
Adding a critic, planner, blacklist, rewrite pass, or global prose example

claimBoundary.coreClaim: New scene prompts defer narration and POV to current explicit direction and do not demand third person.
legacyPathsOrFormats: Existing saved sceneSystemPrompt values containing the old third-person guideline
outOfScopeClaims: Every model stops producing AI-associated prose
Old assistant history stops reinforcing prior style

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: Two simultaneous high-level prompt sources selected incompatible points of view.
contractLaneGate.consumer: Roleplay writer-model requests assembled from persisted scene metadata and Universal preset choices
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: The active preset and newest explicit scene direction own narration and point of view.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: The durable scene guideline defers to the active preset, originating chat, and explicit scene request, preferring the newest explicit scene direction.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: The Roleplay engine owns scene prompt semantics.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not patch React, provider transport, Rust storage, or post-generation output.
regressionProof: Scene creation test rejects the old unconditional third-person wording and requires the new authority rule.
Prompt assembly test proves first_mes and macro-resolved mes_example remain visible beside exactly one generic Roleplay Prose Guidance message.

positiveRows.claim: A Universal V2 scene selecting second-person narration receives a non-conflicting durable scene prompt.
positiveRows.evidence: scene-service.spec.ts passed after failing against the former hardcoded third-person line.

positiveRows.claim: Character-owned positive voice evidence reaches the writer prompt.
positiveRows.evidence: prompt-assembly.roleplay-quality.spec.ts proves first_mes and macro-resolved mes_example are present with one Roleplay prose guide.
51 focused tests, pnpm typecheck, pnpm check:architecture, git diff --check, and full pnpm check passed.

contradictionRows.claim: The old third-person authority cannot remain in newly created scene prompts.
contradictionRows.evidence: Focused test asserts sceneSystemPrompt does not match keep narration in third person.

contradictionRows.claim: The fix must not introduce another universal imitation template.
contradictionRows.evidence: Prompt contract rejects Automatic: and Cleaner: examples and requires exactly one generic prose guide.

legacyDefaultRows.evidence: No storage migration or existing-record rewrite is included; the change applies when new scenes are created.

untestedRows: Subjective prose improvement across every writer model
Live Pi behavior before exact merge-SHA images are deployed

ownedFacts.description: Universal V2 can select second-person narration for a spawned Roleplay scene.
ownedFacts.evidence: The scene creation fixture persists presetChoices.narration as second-person.

reviewThreadLedger.finding: Bunny checked prompt authority, mode isolation, legacy durability, character example visibility, and diff scope.
reviewThreadLedger.fix: No corrective change required after the focused red-green implementation.

verification.baselineCommand: pnpm vitest run src/engine/modes/roleplay/scene/scene-service.spec.ts src/engine/generation/prompt-assembly.roleplay-quality.spec.ts src/engine/generation/prose-shape-guidance.spec.ts; pnpm typecheck; pnpm check:architecture; pnpm check; git diff --check
verification.baselineEvidence: 51 focused tests passed and the full repository gate completed successfully; unused-code output remained warning-only.

notes: No private chat text, provider secrets, or API keys are included.
Production Pi deployment must wait for the exact merge revision's matched server and web image batch.
